sysauto_script.description: Runs the BR Medic anti-pattern scan weekly. The scanner is read-only over the scripted surface (sys_script, sys_script_include, sys_index) and writes only to its own scoped result tables. Delta scanning is driven by the high-water mark recorded on each scan run, so only changed scripts are re-analyzed.
